summary: The candidate fixes both previously reported phase-scoring and D_FF=3 cardinality regressions, but remains a partial implementation of the original issue. Valid decimal sparsities can underflow the floor calculation to a zero-width mask, and prompt rows are pooled across requests instead of applying Equation 2 per request followed by Equation 3.

tests.what_was_measured: Original feature absence on the recorded base; import failed with ModuleNotFoundError because BWAP was not present.

tests.command: At ee5f9f9: pinned Python independent Equation 2 and D_FF=3 scripts
tests.what_was_measured: Reproduced both supplied review counterexamples: old scoring selected neuron 1 instead of 0 and old top-k retained 2 instead of 1.
Candidate focused regression suite: 21 tests and 3 subtests passed.

tests.command: At a74bf498: pinned Python independent scoring/cardinality adversarial script
tests.what_was_measured: Confirmed the two supplied cases pass; found D_FF=5, sparsity=0.8 retains zero rather than one and multi-request prompt pooling changes the top neuron from 1 to 0.

tests.command: At a74bf498 on the assigned GPU: pinned Python independent dense-masked versus gathered reduced-width FFN
tests.what_was_measured: On MI350X gfx950 with D_FF=255, k=127, maximum absolute error was 4.76837158203125e-07.

gpu_evidence: Independent PyTorch execution on AMD Instinct MI350X, gfx950:sramecc+:xnack-, Torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2, HIP 7.2.26015; fused gathered FFN matched dense masked reference.
native_rebuild_evidence: Not applicable: the base-to-candidate diff contains no C/C++/CUDA/HIP/Cython/header/FlyDSL-native source. Candidate BWAP imports resolved to checkout Python sources.
remaining_counterexamples: D_FF=5 and sparsity=0.8: binary floating-point makes (1-sparsity)*D_FF equal 0.9999999999999998, so direct math.floor retains k=0 rather than the mathematical k=1.

A prompt batch with request 1 rows [[0.8,0,0.6]] repeated four times and request 2 row [[0,1,0]] should select neuron 1 after per-request Equation 2 plus Equation 3, but pooled compute_prompt_scores selects neuron 0.
remaining_limitations: No production model weights were available, so semantic accuracy and end-to-end throughput were not independently measured.
The qualified tiny-Llama fixture can only validate transport and engine execution; archived candidate smoke output was not treated as proof of the original feature contract.
NVIDIA, quantized, biased, TP>1, speculative-decode, and unsupported model-architecture paths remain unverified or explicitly unsupported.
